meta.title: Azizillo Tokhirov — Front-end developer & 3D for the web
meta.description: Front-end developer based in Tashkent. Landing pages, online stores and web apps built with Vue and Nuxt. Motion and 3D that never slow the site down.

hero.lead: I build landing pages, stores and web apps with Vue and Nuxt. I add motion and 3D where it sells — and leave it out where it would only slow things down.

services.title: What I do
services.lead: Price and timeline are locked before the work begins. No open-ended estimates.

landing.title: Landing page
landing.description: A one-page site built to turn visitors into enquiries. Design, build, forms, analytics and domain setup.

store.title: Online store
store.description: Catalogue with filters, product pages, cart and checkout. Payment integration and order export included.

app.title: Web application
app.description: An SPA or SSR app on Nuxt: customer dashboards, internal tools, services with accounts and roles.

motion.title: 3D & motion
motion.description: Bringing an existing site to life: WebGL scenes, scroll animation, interactive sections — with no hit to load time.

services.footnote: Need something else? Tell me about it and we'll work it out.

work.title: Selected projects
work.lead: From a store built in plain JavaScript to an experimental interface with motion and sound.

case.notFoundLead: The link may be out of date. Have a look at the other work instead.

process.title: How we work
process.lead: No surprises. You always know which stage the project is at and when it lands.

brief.title: Brief
brief.description: We talk through the goal, the audience and your references. You get an exact quote and timeline. If it isn't a fit, we part ways with no obligation.

design.title: Design
design.description: You see the design before a single line of code is written. Revisions at this stage are free — changing a picture costs far less than rewriting a site.

build.title: Build
build.description: Every few days you get a working link. You watch the progress happen instead of waiting a month in silence.

launch.title: Launch
launch.description: I set up the domain, hosting and analytics, then show you how to edit copy and products yourself. Thirty days of free revisions after handover.

about.title: Azizillo Tokhirov
paragraphs: Front-end developer based in Tashkent. I started with markup at the Proweb IT centre, then moved on to client work, personal projects and a lot of practice with motion and WebGL.
I work in Vue and Nuxt and write TypeScript. I care as much about how fast a site opens as about how it looks: a beautiful site that takes six seconds to load on mobile data is not a beautiful site.
I take on a small number of projects at a time so none of them sit waiting.

contact.title: Tell me about the project
contact.lead: Send me a couple of lines about what you need. I'll reply within a day with whether I can take it, what it costs and when it would be ready.

footer.builtWith: Built with Nuxt, TresJS and three.js
